description_en: Provides a one-click cross-platform product listing optimization service for cross-border e-commerce sellers (best performance edition). Accepts a 1688 product link as input and outputs a complete set of assets adapted to TEMU platform requirements, including titles, attributes, main images, SKU images, detail images, and copywriting. Uses the officially pre-built best-performance workflow to maximize AI capabilities, retains and localizes brand marketing assets, and outputs category-specific assets such as size charts for apparel categories. (Asynchronous)
description_zh: 面向跨境电商卖家的跨平台商品素材一键优化服务（最佳效果版）。输入1688商品链接，一键输出适配TEMU平台要求的标题、属性、主图、SKU图、详情图与文案等全量素材。采用官方预制的最好效果流程，最大化调用AI能力，保留并本地化品牌营销素材，并针对服饰等类目输出尺码表等个性化素材。（异步）
kebab_example: aliyun aidge asset-optimize-pro --product-url https://detail.1688.com/offer/771024907536.html --source-platform 1688 --target-platform temu --need-trans true --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssetOptimizePro

parameters.help_en: The product URL. This parameter is required. Only 1688 product links are supported
parameters.help_zh: 商品URL，必填。目前仅支持1688商品链接
parameters.name: product_url

parameters.help_en: The source platform. Only 1688 is supported
parameters.name: source_platform

parameters.help_en: The target listing platform. Only temu is supported
parameters.name: target_platform

parameters.help_en: The source language code. Optional. Refer to the supported language pairs list for available language directions. Required if NeedTrans is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 源语言代码，选填。支持的语向见翻译支持语向列表。如果NeedTrans为true则必填
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The target language code. Optional. Refer to the supported language pairs list for available language directions. Required if NeedTrans is set to true
parameters.help_zh: 目标语言代码，选填。支持的语向见翻译支持语向列表。如果NeedTrans为true则必填
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether translation is required (true/false). If set to true, SourceLanguage and TargetLanguage are required
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要翻译（true/false）。设为true时，SourceLanguage和TargetLanguage为必填
parameters.name: need_trans

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate text on the product subject area in images. Setting this to false helps protect embedded information such as product names from being translated. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 选择是否翻译图片主体上文字，可帮助保护商品名称等嵌入信息避免被翻译。默认false
parameters.name: including_product_area

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to translate brand names in images. Optional. Default value: false. Setting this to false helps protect brand name information from being translated
parameters.help_zh: 是否翻译图片上的品牌名，选填，默认false。可帮助保护品牌名信息避免被翻译
parameters.name: translating_brand_in_the_product

parameters.help_en: The glossary ID. Optional. Create a glossary separately in the console and provide its ID. If empty, translation results are not modified
parameters.help_zh: 干预词表ID，选填。需在前台单独创建并提供其ID。如果为空则翻译结果不会被修改
parameters.name: glossary

parameters.help_en: The confidence threshold for size chart detection. Default value: 0.4. A value of 0 treats all images as size charts. A value of 1 treats no images as size charts
parameters.help_zh: 尺码图检测置信度，默认为0.4。设为0时全部都认为是尺码表，设为1时全不是尺码表
parameters.name: threshold

parameters.help_en: The list of column names to recognize in size chart images. Optional
parameters.help_zh: 尺码图需要识别的列名列表，选填
parameters.name: column_name_list

parameters.help_en: The output language format for size chart images. If not specified, the original format is used. Set to en for English output or cn for Chinese output
parameters.help_zh: 尺码图输出语言格式，不填默认原版输出。en输出英文，cn输出中文
parameters.name: language_model

Code.description_en: The status code. The value "success" is returned for a successful call
Code.description_zh: 状态码，正常调用时返回"success"

Data.description_en: The asynchronous task submission result data, which contains the asynchronous task ID
Data.description_zh: 异步任务提交结果数据，包含异步任务ID

TaskId.description_en: The asynchronous task ID, used to query processing results through QueryAsyncTaskResult
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务ID，用于后续通过QueryAsyncTaskResult查询处理结果
TaskId.title_en: 异步任务ID，用于后续查询结果
TaskId.title_zh: 异步任务ID，用于后续查询结果

Message.description_en: The error message. The value "Success" is returned for a successful call
Message.description_zh: 报错信息。正常调用时返回"Success"

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used to uniquely identify a single API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用来识别唯一一次请求调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 是否调用成功。true代表成功，false代表失败
